description: Sasha discusses what a Neural Labs agency or advisory engagement would cost. She asks about scope before naming a figure and quotes only Neural Partners' approved starting points, each of which depends on the work. structuredContent.prices carries exactly the approved figures her reply quoted, from configuration, with their conditions. Sasha is an AI agent built on Claude and can be wrong. Prices are starting points only. Chats are kept up to 90 days. She never books or submits anything.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id an earlier call returned. Omitted, a new conversation starts. Earlier turns are kept server-side, so only the new message is sent.

message.description: The pricing question, or what the work is, in plain text.

name: pricing_discovery

conversation_id.description: Continues this conversation on a later call.

degraded.description: True when the reply is a stand-in because Sasha ran out of time; the same message can be sent again.

disclosure.description: Present on the first reply of a conversation: what the person should know about Sasha. Also sent as its own first content block.

error.description: Present only on a result with isError: true.

links.description: The Neural Partners pages Sasha's reply pointed at, as absolute URLs. Only pages on the Neural Partners site are ever listed. Empty when she pointed at none.

offer_handoff.description: True on the reply where Sasha offers to pass the conversation to the Neural Partners team.

prices.description: The approved Neural Partners starting prices Sasha's reply quoted, read from Neural Partners' configuration rather than from the reply text. Empty when she quoted none.

kind.description: media-budget is paid by the client to ad platforms, not to Neural Partners.

note.description: The conditions the figure is quoted under.

unit.description: What the amount is per, e.g. project or month.

reply.description: Sasha's reply, on its own. The disclosure is never part of it.

title: Neural Labs pricing discovery
